title: 量化记忆到泛化的转变：Grokking 的缩放定律与相结构
summary: 该研究通过 384 组 MLP 配置绘制了模运算任务中记忆到泛化的边界，拟合出泛化起始时间的幂律缩放关系，发现数据复杂度是主导因素而非模型容量，并揭示了权重衰减的相变边界。
summary_en: This study maps the memorization-to-generalization boundary across 384 MLP configurations on modular arithmetic, fitting a power-law scaling relation for generalization onset time. It finds data complexity dominates over model capacity and reveals a sharp phase boundary at weight decay.
